quirks.description: WordPress wraps all content in div.wp-site-blocks (block themes) or div#page (classic themes), causing probe to see only 1-3 body children and falsely flag as SPA.
quirks.workaround: The adapter's spaContainerHints automatically unwrap the single container. The isSPA flag can be ignored for WordPress sites.

quirks.description: Security-conscious WP sites strip meta[name=generator], link[rel=api.w.org], _wpemojiSettings, X-Pingback header. Only window.wp + /wp-content/ survive.
quirks.workaround: Never rely on a single detection signal. The combination of window.wp + /wp-content/ URL pattern is the minimum reliable detection set.

quirks.description: Block themes (WP 5.9+) use div.wp-site-blocks > header + main#wp--skip-link--target + footer. Classic themes use div#page.site > header#masthead + div#content > main.site-main + footer#colophon.
quirks.workaround: Use '.wp-site-blocks > *, div#page > *' as primarySelector to cover both theme architectures.

quirks.description: WordPress lazy-load plugins use varying attributes: data-src, data-lazy-src, data-original, native loading="lazy".
quirks.workaround: Check data-src, data-lazy-src, and src attributes. Scroll to trigger intersection-observer-based lazy loaders.

quirks.description: Jetpack rewrites image URLs to i0.wp.com, i1.wp.com, i2.wp.com CDN with resize params.
quirks.workaround: Match i[0-2]\.wp\.com in image URLs. Strip ?w=&h= params to get original image.

quirks.description: WordPress REST API is available at /wp-json/wp/v2/ and may expose page/post data.
quirks.workaround: Can fetch structured content from /wp-json/wp/v2/pages and /wp-json/wp/v2/posts if needed.

localSite.sectionSelector: .wp-site-blocks > header, .wp-site-blocks > main > *, .wp-site-blocks > footer, div#page > header, div#page > div#content > main > *, div#page > footer
